title: BCZ YapZ w/Diviflyy
summary: In this episode of BCZ YapZ, Zaal sits down with Adrian (aka Divifly), the lead developer behind Empire Builder, for a deep dive into the technical infrastructure and future roadmap of the platform. Adrian shares his long history in the cryptocurrency space-from mining Dogecoin on a laptop in 2013 and navigating the 2017 ICO boom to his work as a technical writer for major protocols like Scroll and Rootstock.
